algorithm: {The algorithm prioritizes bins with the largest remaining capacity to maintain balance and minimize fragmentation, assigning higher priority to bins that can accommodate the item with more room left.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    return bins - item

algorithm: {The algorithm prioritizes bins with the smallest remaining capacity after adding the item, favoring tighter fits to reduce wasted space and pack items more densely.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    return -(bins - item)
